The land use compatibility chart indicates that for Ldn values of 60 to 70 in parks, playgrounds and single or multi-family residential areas, special conditions may be imposed. These include "limiting outdoor activity to accoustically treated areas and remedial sound attenuation treatment for existing uses." Areas with Ldn values of 70-80 must receive "top priority for remedial sound attenuation treatment". Those areas of the target neighborhoods which meet these criteria are identified below. If housing units to be rehabilitated are selected within the areas described above, remedial sound attenuation measures must be included in the improvements. These remedial measures would include such measures as a central ventilation system to eliminate open windows, double pane windows, weather-stripping and replacement of hollow-core exterior doors.
